rows.ja: 新造船の発注先(造船所)

relations.text: 9万立方メートル級VLGC1隻を約1.15億ドルで発注(2029年7月引き渡し予定)
relations.text_en: Ordered one 90,000 cbm VLGC for about $115 million (delivery July 2029)

source.label: Dorian LPG 8-K(2026年6月、新造船発注)
source.quote: today announced that it entered into an agreement with HD Hyundai to build one 90,000 cbm VLGC for delivery in July 2029 for a price of approximately $115 million.

relations.text: 二元燃料VLGC3隻を約3.45億ドルで発注(2030年引き渡し予定)
relations.text_en: Ordered three dual-fuel VLGCs for about $345 million (delivery in 2030)

source.label: Dorian LPG 8-K(2026年9月、新造船発注)
source.quote: today announced that it entered into an agreement with Hanwha Ocean to build three 90,000 cbm dual-fuel Panamax VLGCs for delivery in June, September, and December of 2030 for a total price of approximately $345 million.

relations.text: 子会社MOL Energiaと運航プールHeliosを50%ずつ保有
relations.text_en: Its subsidiary MOL Energia co-owns the Helios Pool 50/50

source.label: Dorian LPG 10-K(2026年3月期)
source.quote: Ltd., a wholly-owned subsidiary of Mitsui OSK Lines Ltd., an unaffiliated third party, began operation of Helios LPG Pool LLC, (the "Helios Pool"), a joint venture owned 50% by us and 50% by MOL Energia.

note.ja: 公式資料で確認できた関係だけを載せています。投資判断を勧めるものではありません。
note.en: Only relationships confirmed in official materials are shown. Not investment advice.
